subject.title: [Bug]: Managed Memory Dreaming Promotion cron silently NO_REPLY since 2026-05-09 (jobs.json lastRun stays null)

question: Should managed Memory Dreaming sweeps that produce no diary or have per-workspace failures be recorded as cron ok, skipped/degraded diagnostics, or error?
rationale: Current source separates plugin-local failure accounting from cron's outer run status, and changing that contract affects alerts, retries, and expected no-op sweeps.

options.title: Add degraded diagnostics
options.body: Surface failed or no-op Dreaming sweeps in cron diagnostics, doctor, and run history without treating every zero-promotion run as fatal.

options.title: Mark workspace failures as errors
options.body: Make any per-workspace Dreaming failure propagate to cron error state, failure notifications, and backoff counters.

options.title: Preserve cron ok
options.body: Keep outer cron success semantics and rely on memory status, logs, or doctor warnings for Dreaming-specific failure visibility.

recommendation.title: Add degraded diagnostics
recommendation.body: Surface failed or no-op Dreaming sweeps in cron diagnostics, doctor, and run history without treating every zero-promotion run as fatal.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent SQLite Dreaming-state repair makes steipete the clearest owner for deciding whether the remaining status semantics belong in memory-core, cron, or doctor.
